nusmp.skill.grimoire_eye.description: Grimoire magic: Eye Magic. The mage casts enchantments through their eyes: a gaze that strikes, marks, blinds and weakens, eyes that hunt on their own, a ward that turns shots back on the shooter, a step to wherever the mage can see, and the Union Magic Reflect Iris that paralyses everyone who looks into its mirrors. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_eye.description: The grimoire of Eye Magic: twelve pages of sight turned into a weapon. Starters strike with a look; mid pages send homing eyes, mark a target so it takes more from you and your allies, blind a crowd, curse with the Evil Eye, sharpen your own sight, ward off projectiles and step to where you look; the zone page opens a Field of Eyes, the signature is Reflect Iris, and the daily is the All-Seeing Eye that shows everything nearby through walls. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.page.book_eye.eye_strike: A bolt of focused sight leaves the eye and runs straight through whatever stands in its way. It flies 22 blocks at speed 1.6 and pierces every enemy on its line for 8 damage, scaled by Existence Points.
nusmp.page.book_eye.piercing_glance: Nothing hides from a glance that has already decided where to land. Strikes the first target in sight within 28 blocks for 7 damage and makes it glow for 5 seconds; an invisible target is revealed and takes 50% more (10.5). Damage scales with Existence Points.
nusmp.page.book_eye.seeker_eyes: Four small eyes slip out of the grimoire and follow the magic of whoever is nearest. Each flies at speed 1.25, homes on the closest enemies within 16 blocks and hits for 5 damage, blinds for 2 seconds and bleeds 1% of the target's magicules. Damage scales with Existence Points.
nusmp.page.book_eye.mark_of_sight: A mark burned into the sight of the world: the target can no longer be lost. Marks one target within 32 blocks for 12 seconds: it glows through walls, loses invisibility and takes 25% more damage from you and your allies. Deals 2 damage on cast.
nusmp.page.book_eye.blinding_flash: The eyes open wide and the light inside them is too much to look at. Everyone in front of you within 9 blocks takes 4 damage and is blinded for 6 seconds (bosses 1.5 seconds), and monsters lose their target on you. Needs at least one enemy in the cone. Damage scales with Existence Points.
nusmp.page.book_eye.evil_eye: A long look that takes more than it shows. One target within 24 blocks takes 4 damage, Weakness II for 12 seconds, Slowness and Mining Fatigue for 6 seconds and Fragility (lower resistance) for 6 seconds, and you drink 5% of its magicules (1% from bosses).
nusmp.page.book_eye.keen_sight: Sharpen the eyes until the dark is only another colour. For 30 seconds you gain Night Vision and Speed, and your melee hits deal 3 extra damage scaled by Existence Points.
nusmp.page.book_eye.iris_ward: A wide iris opens around the mage and shows every shot its own aim. For 8 seconds enemy projectiles that enter 4.5 blocks around you (up to 14) are turned back at whoever fired them and become yours, and that shooter is jammed (Magic Jamming) for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_eye.sight_step: Where the eyes can see, the body can already stand. Teleports you to the spot you are looking at, up to 16 blocks away and never through a wall, resets fall damage and gives Night Vision for 5 seconds. Up to 8 enemies along the path are revealed and glow for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_eye.field_of_eyes: The ground opens a hundred lidless eyes, and none of them blink. A 6 block zone at the target point lasting 8 seconds: every 0.5 seconds up to 12 enemies inside take 1.5 damage, glow, get Weakness, are jammed (Magic Jamming) and lose 0.5% of their magicules. Invisible enemies are revealed.
nusmp.page.book_eye.reflect_iris: Union Magic: an array of mirrors turns round the mage, and anyone who looks into it sees their own eyes looking back. For 6 seconds, up to 8 enemies within 8 blocks who look at you are paralysed for up to 2.5 seconds (bosses 1 second) with their magic blocked for 3 seconds longer, then struck by Reflect Refrain for 14 damage scaled by Existence Points. Uses the shared control lock.
nusmp.page.book_eye.all_seeing_eye: The mage opens the eye that never closes and the whole country lies open. For 30 seconds you have Night Vision, everything alive within 40 blocks glows through walls (invisible ones too), and up to 40 are tracked. Foes within 20 blocks stay marked and take 25% more from you and your allies. Daily: 10 minute cooldown.
